workflow: Consolidating monthly financial reports from multiple departments into a single master spreadsheet
current_workaround: Manually copy-pasting data from each department's Excel file into a master workbook, then reconciling totals
consequence: Errors in consolidated reports lead to misstated financials, delayed month-end close, and rework

workflow: Merging customer lists from multiple CRM exports into a single clean file for a marketing campaign
current_workaround: Manually deduplicating and merging CSV files in Excel using VLOOKUP and conditional formatting
consequence: Duplicate contacts cause wasted ad spend and poor campaign performance; missing contacts reduce reach

workflow: Combining weekly sales data from multiple regional teams into a unified performance dashboard
current_workaround: Each regional manager sends a separate Excel file; analyst manually copies data into a master sheet and creates pivot tables
consequence: Delayed reports, inconsistent formatting, and errors in sales forecasts

workflow: Merging employee survey responses from multiple Qualtrics exports into a single analysis file
current_workaround: Downloading CSV files from Qualtrics, then manually combining them in Excel with copy-paste and text-to-columns
consequence: Time wasted on data prep instead of analysis; risk of data corruption or misalignment

workflow: Reconciling inventory data from multiple warehouse management systems into a single Excel file for reporting
current_workaround: Exporting data from each WMS, then manually matching SKUs and quantities in Excel using VLOOKUP and conditional formatting
consequence: Inventory discrepancies lead to stockouts or overstock, costing thousands in lost sales or carrying costs

workflow: Merging Google Analytics and Facebook Ads export data into a single performance report
current_workaround: Manually downloading CSV reports from each platform, then combining them in Excel with pivot tables and manual formulas
consequence: Inconsistent metrics across platforms lead to inaccurate ROI calculations and poor budget allocation decisions

workflow: Merging property listing data from multiple MLS feeds into a single spreadsheet for comparative market analysis
current_workaround: Copy-pasting data from each MLS website into Excel, then manually deduplicating and formatting
consequence: Time-consuming process delays client reports; errors in data can lead to incorrect valuations
